checksum.empty: A risk-summary checksum is produced once a profile has been computed.
checksum.subtitle: A limited SHA-256 checksum of the vehicle ID, window bounds, selected timezone, risk score, frequency, severity and loss-cost indices, and ordered factor codes and observed rates at fixed precision. It does not verify identity or hash the complete evidence packet: raw exposure, other factor details, policy, premium, trend and evidence are not included. Matching checksums do not establish that the complete datasets are identical.

review.otherFees: All other line fees (zero if fully itemized and none)
review.quiet: No material difference was found in the components that could be compared.
review.rateEnergy: Energy covered by that rate amount (Wh)
